subject: MAP alignment and PO / invoicing constraints for onramp
messages:
From: Tom Brooks <tom.brooks@acmehealth.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 11 Feb 2026 09:17:00 -0500
Subject: MAP & PO question — evaluation milestones and billing start

Evelyn,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team is excited about the latency/cost profile you showed. We want to lock down the mutual action plan (MAP) and understand how commercial milestones will map to invoicing so procurement can prepare a PO. A few specific asks to get us unblocked: 

- Can you share a simple invoice cadence tied to MAP milestones (trial evaluation, pilot commit, ramp to prod)?
- What are typical billing start triggers for Redwood — signing vs. PO receipt vs. go-live?
- On payment terms: we typically need Net60 for new vendors; is Net60 acceptable or can we negotiate Net30/Net45?
- Any required PO data fields or contract countersign workflow we should include?

I've attached a high-level evaluation plan (Acme_EvalPlan_v1.pdf) — it lists expected milestones and timeline. Procurement will want to see an example invoice flow before raising a PO.

Laura Chen (Procurement) is looped here. Appreciate a clear bullet list we can share with procurement.

Tom

Attachment: Acme_EvalPlan_v1.pdf (application/pdf)

--
Tom Brooks
Director, Platform Integrations
Acme Health
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
To: Tom Brooks <tom.brooks@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 11 Feb 2026 12:03:00 -0500
Subject: Re: MAP & PO question — evaluation milestones and billing start

Tom — thanks for the clear list. Below is a concise playbook we use with customers in the same procurement position; happy to tweak to Acme-specific fields. High level: commercial terms are typically tied to MAP milestones (Evaluation -> Pilot commit -> Ramp / Go-live).

Proposed invoice cadence (default):
- Initial invoice (50% of first-year committed spend) issued on sign + Net30; customer submits PO to match invoice number.
- Remaining 50% invoiced at go-live (production ramp) Net30.
- Ongoing monthly usage invoiced in arrears after billing start date (Net30) unless otherwise negotiated.

Billing start triggers we accept (in order of preference):
1) Signed SOW + PO on file (preferred for enterprise)
2) Signed SOW + initial invoice paid (if PO issuance is delayed)
3) Technically we can start invoicing at defined go-live date if the customer requires billing only after acceptance testing; this often pushes our first invoice out.

Payment terms we commonly offer: Net30 (standard), Net45 (by exception), Net60 (possible for enterprise deals with approved credit profile and paperwork). If Net60, we typically offset with a smaller one-time discount (1–2%) or milestone-based payment (e.g., partial upfront).

PO fields we need:
- PO number (mandatory)
- Bill-to name + address
- Tax ID (if applicable)
- Contact for remittance

Attached is a draft MAP workbook (RW_MAP_draft.xlsx) showing pricing tied to each milestone and a sample invoicing row. Next steps I recommend: 
1) Procurement to confirm whether Net60 is required (and whether a partial upfront can be offered).
2) If Net60 required, let us review what discount / onboarding credits are acceptable.
3) We'll circulate a one-page SOW + DocuSign link once commercials agreed.

Happy to jump on a short procurement/finance call if that helps.

Best,
Evelyn

--
Evelyn Hart
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Tom Brooks <tom.brooks@acmehealth.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 12 Feb 2026 08:22:00 -0500
Subject: Re: MAP & PO question — invoice cadence options + discount tie to commit

Tom / Evelyn — chiming in from Solutions to offer an alternate cadence we’ve used with healthcare customers where procurement requires Net60 but the customer still wants production start predictable. Notes below: 

Alternate commercial structure (used successfully):
- 30% due on sign (invoice Net30) — customer provides PO referencing invoice
- 40% due at go-live / production ramp (Net30)
- Remaining 30% split over first 3 months of production as equal monthly invoices (Net30)

Why this helps procurement: reduces initial cash burden vs. 50% upfront, while giving Redwood committed ramp dollars earlier.

Discount / credit options if Net60 required:
- Option A: Net60 + 1.5% one-time discount off first-year committed spend
- Option B: Net60 + $Xk onboarding credit applied to first two invoices

Operational asks from procurement for any of the above: 
- PO prior to invoicing (we can issue an invoice referencing a pending PO but require a PO number before payment processing).
- Billing contact and remittance email to be included on PO.

DocuSign link and a sample SOW will be provided by Evelyn once we agree the structure. I’ll also attach our SOC2 statement if procurement needs it for vendor review.

Attachment: Acme_SOC2_v2.pdf (application/pdf)

Thanks,
Karthik
Solutions Engineering, Redwood Inference
From: Laura Chen <laura.chen@acmehealth.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Brooks <tom.brooks@acmehealth.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Feb 2026 15:02:00 -0500
Subject: Re: MAP & PO question — invoice cadence options + discount tie to commit

Evelyn / Karthik — procurement reviewed the options. We have two constraints that will determine our path: 

1) Our vendor policy requires Net60 for new vendors unless a business justification is approved.
2) We must have a PO on file before any invoice can be processed; PO needs bill-to address, contact, and Tax ID.

Given that, our preferred approach is the alternate structure Karthik proposed but with Net60 on all invoices. To compensate Redwood for extended pay terms, we can accept a smaller discount (1%) or an onboarding credit. Procurement preference: onboarding credit rather than percentage discount.

Action items we need from you to raise the PO: 
- Final one-page SOW with line-item pricing and the split invoicing rows (please include invoice descriptions matching the MAP milestones).
- Remittance contact + billing address + Redwood Tax ID (for PO).
- DocuSign link for signature.

We will issue the PO as soon as SOW and billing details are received; billing start should be set to the date of the first invoice issuance (which per structure will be on sign).

We prefer onboarding credit of $25,000 rather than percentage discount. If that’s acceptable, we can proceed with PO and Net60. Otherwise procurement will require finance approval which will add ~2 weeks.

Thanks,
Laura Chen
Senior Procurement Manager
Acme Health
